programme.title: Kenny Barron
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Jaco Pastorius
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world. In this concert, he is accompanied by Peter Erskine (drums), Don Alias (percussion), Othello Molineaux (steel drums), Bob Mintzer (tenor sax and bass clarinet), and Randy Brecker (trumpet and electronics). They perform “Chicken”, “Donna Lee”, “Mr. Phone Bone”, and “Fannie Mae”. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity to experience Jaco Pastorius's electrifying performance at the Montreal Jazz Festival 1982!

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah
programme.sub-title: Live at A to JazZ Festival, Sofia
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music” an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content. Trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah's quintet, which includes drummer Corey Fonville, percussionist Weedie Braimah, pianist Lawrence Fields, and bass guitarist Max Mucha, delivered a performance that defied boundaries and expectations.

programme.title: Dexter Gordon
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Errol Garner
programme.sub-title: Erroll Garner - Live in Singer Concertzaal, Laren
programme.desc: On June 18, 1962, American pianist and composer Erroll Garner performed at the Singer Concertzaal in Laren. The vibrant and joyous concert was played with drummer Kelly Martin and bassist Eddie Calhoun, each long-standing collaborators from Garner's trio. The Singer Concertzaal in Laren, the Netherlands is a concert hall and museum dedicated to the preservation of the art collection of American William Henry Singer. It features a variety of artists, both visual and aural.

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Red Norvo, Dave Brubeck Quartet, The Gary Burton Quartet & Dizzy Gillespie
programme.sub-title: G.B. 4, Red N., D.G. Band, D.B. 4 - Newport Jazz
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. In 1968, jazz's greatest artists appeared at the third Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam. This broadcast features the bands of pianist Dave Brubeck, vibraphonists Gary Burton and Red Norvo, and trumpeter Dizzy Gillespie.

programme.title: Silvia Chiesa & Maurizio Baglini
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform a wonderful recital of works by Ferruccio Busoni, Franz Liszt, Frédéric Chopin, and Sergei Rachmaninoff. On the program are Busoni's Kultaselle – 10 variations on a Finnish folksong Liszt's Two Elegies for cello and piano Chopin's Introduction and Polonaise brillante in C major, Op. 3 and Rachmaninoff's Sonata in G minor for cello and piano, Op. 19. As an encore, the duo plays Leonard Bernstein's iconic composition ‘Tonight' from the musical West Side Story. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Milan, Italy, on November 4, 2024.

programme.title: Sinne Eeg & Jimmy J¢rgensen
programme.desc: It's going to be fast, really fast! All your favourite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the Concert Hall - together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras. Cartoons are for children and adults alike - and the music in them is at least as entertaining as the pictures! It will be fun, touching, crazy and dramatic when the Concert Hall is filled with living lines drawn in tones in the big room. The DR Symphony Orchestra, DR Big Band and DR Vocal Ensemble have joined forces to take you to a party in the cartoon universes.

programme.title: Jonathon Heyward & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: American conductor Jonathon Heyward makes his debut with the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) with this performance of Antonín Dvořák's beloved Symphony No. 9 in E minor, Op. 95, "From the New World". Composed during Dvořák's stay in the United States, the work blends Bohemian warmth with the rhythms and spirit of American musical traditions. A deeply expressive and melodic masterpiece, it remains one of the most popular symphonies of all time. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke's on Old Street in London, UK, on September 30, 2020.

programme.title: Václav Luks & Collegium 1704
programme.desc: J. S. Bach's six Brandenburg Concerto's belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces' 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach's Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. This performance was recorded at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany.

programme.title: Benjamin Haemhouts, Casco Phil & Geert Baeckelandt
programme.sub-title: Mozart – Clarinet Concerto in A Major
programme.desc: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart wrote his last completely instrumental piece in 1791. Clarinet Concerto in A Major was written for his friend Anton Stadler, who gave the first performance of it in Prague to a great reception according to the Berlin Musikalisches Wochenblatt. Today, a major part of the first movement is often used in auditions for orchestras and music schools. In this broadcast, the piece is performed by Casco Phil, a Belgian chamber orchestra led by Benjamin Haemhouts. Belgian clarinettist Geert Baeckelandt is the featured soloist.

programme.title: Isabel Schwartzbach, Eivør Pálsdóttir & Adam Riis
programme.desc: Explore the captivating sounds of epic gaming worlds brought to life by 150 musicians and singers at DR Koncerthuset. The Danish National Symphony Orchestra transforms the stage into enchanted musical landscapes inspired by legendary video games such as The Legend of Zelda and League of Legends, featuring Nordic vocalist Eivør as a special guest in Legends Never Die and more.

programme.title: Deep Purple
programme.desc: Filmed in the spectacular surroundings of the Arena di Verona, a Roman amphitheater originally built in 30 AD, this concert from the summer of 2011 sees Deep Purple joined on stage by a full symphony orchestra for performances of all their classic tracks. Deep Purple remains one of the finest hard rock bands on the planet and are undoubtedly at their best when performing live. Here, the orchestral arrangements give an added depth and range to the familiar songs. The band responds to both playing with the orchestra and performing in such a historical location to deliver a brilliant show in front of a huge and enthusiastic crowd.

programme.title: John Mellencamp
programme.desc: John Mellencamp's career in music, spanning more than 42 years, has seen him transition from pop star to one of the most highly regarded songwriters of a generation. Filmed at the landmark Chicago Theatre, just 250 miles away from his upbringing in Indiana, this cinematic concert documentary film captures John Mellencamp reflecting on his career accompanied by self-narration from his highly personal audio diary on his Midwestern upbringing, career and outlook on life as a whole. Meant to be more than just your run of the mill concert film, this intimate performance with full band will fully envelop the viewer into the Mellencamp mindset. “My vision was true, and my heart was too. And there was no end to what I could dream. Life is short, even in its longest days.”

programme.title: Foreigner
programme.desc: Featuring the classic Foreigner line-up of Jones, Gramm, McDonald, Greenwood, Gagliardi and Elliott, this show captures the essence of a group who would go on to become one of the best-selling bands of all time. On April 27 1978, after their self-titled debut album had spent a year in the US Top 20, rock's conquering heroes played a sold-out show at London's legendary music venue, the Rainbow Theatre. Opening with 'Long, Long Way From Home', the band's legion of fans were treated to a magnificent display of musicianship and performance, including local hit singles, 'Feels Like The First Time' and 'Cold As Ice', as well as an exclusive preview of two tracks from the upcoming ‘Double Vision' album. Forty years on, this definitive performance by the original band has been restored from the original film reels, remixed and remastered for this release.

programme.title: Lynyrd Skynyrd
programme.desc: Earlier this year Lynyrd Skynyrd performed their first two studio albums, “Pronounced ‘Lĕh-'nérd ‘Skin-'nérd” and “Second Helping”, live in their entirety for the first time, at two specially staged concerts at the Florida Theatre in their home town of Jacksonville, Florida. It was a special occasion for both the act and their fans as the band performed tracks they'd never or rarely played live before alongside classic songs that are an essential part of any Lynyrd Skynyrd live show. These unique concerts are a must have for any Lynyrd Skynyrd fan.

A razor-sharp and delightfully heartwarming festive comedy, packed with classic Christmas songs and a stand-out ensemble cast, including Joel Murray (Mad Men), Sawyer Spielberg (Masters of the Air), Susan Gallagher (Cobra Kai), Neil Casey (Ghostbusters, Avenue 5), Comfort Clinton (Billions, FBI), Sophie von Haselberg (Give Me Pity, Pose) and Raye Spielberg.

Their rip-roaring odyssey leads them through various subcultures of Los Angeles, including an Armenian family dealing with their own repercussions of infidelity.

programme.title: Kenny Barron
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Jaco Pastorius
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world. In this concert, he is accompanied by Peter Erskine (drums), Don Alias (percussion), Othello Molineaux (steel drums), Bob Mintzer (tenor sax and bass clarinet), and Randy Brecker (trumpet and electronics). They perform “Chicken”, “Donna Lee”, “Mr. Phone Bone”, and “Fannie Mae”. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity to experience Jaco Pastorius's electrifying performance at the Montreal Jazz Festival 1982!

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah
programme.sub-title: Live at A to JazZ Festival, Sofia
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music” an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content. Trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah's quintet, which includes drummer Corey Fonville, percussionist Weedie Braimah, pianist Lawrence Fields, and bass guitarist Max Mucha, delivered a performance that defied boundaries and expectations.

programme.title: Dexter Gordon
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Errol Garner
programme.sub-title: Erroll Garner - Live in Singer Concertzaal, Laren
programme.desc: On June 18, 1962, American pianist and composer Erroll Garner performed at the Singer Concertzaal in Laren. The vibrant and joyous concert was played with drummer Kelly Martin and bassist Eddie Calhoun, each long-standing collaborators from Garner's trio. The Singer Concertzaal in Laren, the Netherlands is a concert hall and museum dedicated to the preservation of the art collection of American William Henry Singer. It features a variety of artists, both visual and aural.

programme.title: Red Norvo, Dave Brubeck Quartet, The Gary Burton Quartet & Dizzy Gillespie
programme.sub-title: G.B. 4, Red N., D.G. Band, D.B. 4 - Newport Jazz
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. In 1968, jazz's greatest artists appeared at the third Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam. This broadcast features the bands of pianist Dave Brubeck, vibraphonists Gary Burton and Red Norvo, and trumpeter Dizzy Gillespie.

programme.title: Silvia Chiesa & Maurizio Baglini
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform a wonderful recital of works by Ferruccio Busoni, Franz Liszt, Frédéric Chopin, and Sergei Rachmaninoff. On the program are Busoni's Kultaselle – 10 variations on a Finnish folksong Liszt's Two Elegies for cello and piano Chopin's Introduction and Polonaise brillante in C major, Op. 3 and Rachmaninoff's Sonata in G minor for cello and piano, Op. 19. As an encore, the duo plays Leonard Bernstein's iconic composition ‘Tonight' from the musical West Side Story. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Milan, Italy, on November 4, 2024.

programme.title: Sinne Eeg & Jimmy J¢rgensen
programme.desc: It's going to be fast, really fast! All your favourite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the Concert Hall - together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras. Cartoons are for children and adults alike - and the music in them is at least as entertaining as the pictures! It will be fun, touching, crazy and dramatic when the Concert Hall is filled with living lines drawn in tones in the big room. The DR Symphony Orchestra, DR Big Band and DR Vocal Ensemble have joined forces to take you to a party in the cartoon universes.

programme.title: Jonathon Heyward & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: American conductor Jonathon Heyward makes his debut with the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) with this performance of Antonín Dvořák's beloved Symphony No. 9 in E minor, Op. 95, "From the New World". Composed during Dvořák's stay in the United States, the work blends Bohemian warmth with the rhythms and spirit of American musical traditions. A deeply expressive and melodic masterpiece, it remains one of the most popular symphonies of all time. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke's on Old Street in London, UK, on September 30, 2020.

programme.title: Václav Luks & Collegium 1704
programme.desc: J. S. Bach's six Brandenburg Concerto's belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces' 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach's Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. This performance was recorded at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany.

programme.title: Benjamin Haemhouts, Casco Phil & Geert Baeckelandt
programme.sub-title: Mozart – Clarinet Concerto in A Major
programme.desc: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart wrote his last completely instrumental piece in 1791. Clarinet Concerto in A Major was written for his friend Anton Stadler, who gave the first performance of it in Prague to a great reception according to the Berlin Musikalisches Wochenblatt. Today, a major part of the first movement is often used in auditions for orchestras and music schools. In this broadcast, the piece is performed by Casco Phil, a Belgian chamber orchestra led by Benjamin Haemhouts. Belgian clarinettist Geert Baeckelandt is the featured soloist.

programme.title: Isabel Schwartzbach, Eivør Pálsdóttir & Adam Riis
programme.desc: Explore the captivating sounds of epic gaming worlds brought to life by 150 musicians and singers at DR Koncerthuset. The Danish National Symphony Orchestra transforms the stage into enchanted musical landscapes inspired by legendary video games such as The Legend of Zelda and League of Legends, featuring Nordic vocalist Eivør as a special guest in Legends Never Die and more.

programme.title: Deep Purple
programme.desc: Filmed in the spectacular surroundings of the Arena di Verona, a Roman amphitheater originally built in 30 AD, this concert from the summer of 2011 sees Deep Purple joined on stage by a full symphony orchestra for performances of all their classic tracks. Deep Purple remains one of the finest hard rock bands on the planet and are undoubtedly at their best when performing live. Here, the orchestral arrangements give an added depth and range to the familiar songs. The band responds to both playing with the orchestra and performing in such a historical location to deliver a brilliant show in front of a huge and enthusiastic crowd.

programme.title: John Mellencamp
programme.desc: John Mellencamp's career in music, spanning more than 42 years, has seen him transition from pop star to one of the most highly regarded songwriters of a generation. Filmed at the landmark Chicago Theatre, just 250 miles away from his upbringing in Indiana, this cinematic concert documentary film captures John Mellencamp reflecting on his career accompanied by self-narration from his highly personal audio diary on his Midwestern upbringing, career and outlook on life as a whole. Meant to be more than just your run of the mill concert film, this intimate performance with full band will fully envelop the viewer into the Mellencamp mindset. “My vision was true, and my heart was too. And there was no end to what I could dream. Life is short, even in its longest days.”

programme.title: Foreigner
programme.desc: Featuring the classic Foreigner line-up of Jones, Gramm, McDonald, Greenwood, Gagliardi and Elliott, this show captures the essence of a group who would go on to become one of the best-selling bands of all time. On April 27 1978, after their self-titled debut album had spent a year in the US Top 20, rock's conquering heroes played a sold-out show at London's legendary music venue, the Rainbow Theatre. Opening with 'Long, Long Way From Home', the band's legion of fans were treated to a magnificent display of musicianship and performance, including local hit singles, 'Feels Like The First Time' and 'Cold As Ice', as well as an exclusive preview of two tracks from the upcoming ‘Double Vision' album. Forty years on, this definitive performance by the original band has been restored from the original film reels, remixed and remastered for this release.

programme.title: Lynyrd Skynyrd
programme.desc: Earlier this year Lynyrd Skynyrd performed their first two studio albums, “Pronounced ‘Lĕh-'nérd ‘Skin-'nérd” and “Second Helping”, live in their entirety for the first time, at two specially staged concerts at the Florida Theatre in their home town of Jacksonville, Florida. It was a special occasion for both the act and their fans as the band performed tracks they'd never or rarely played live before alongside classic songs that are an essential part of any Lynyrd Skynyrd live show. These unique concerts are a must have for any Lynyrd Skynyrd fan.

Planean robar y vender un nuevo antídoto para curar un virus parecido al del SIDA llamado STBO, que está matando a los que practican el amor sin amor, pero necesitan un cómplice. Reclutan a Alex, apodado “lengua veloz”, un chico rebelde que está rompiendo su relación con Lisa, su novia de 16 años de edad. Poco antes del robo, las cosas se complican.

programme.desc: Mia, una adolescente frustrada y solitaria de 15 años, huérfana de padre y cuya madre apenas se ocupa de ella, se enfada cuando se entera de que ésta sale con un hombre, el atractivo Connor.

programme.title: El caso Sloane
programme.desc: Maquiavélica película en clave de thriller político tenso y locuaz que recuerda a los mejores guiones de Aaron Sorkin ('El ala oeste de la casa blanca'). Una implacable y ambiciosa activista luchará contra un poderoso lobby en un intento de cambiar la legislación sobre el control y venta de armas.

programme.title: Un puente hacia Terabithia
programme.desc: Jess Aarons se siente extraño tanto en el colegio como en su propia casa. Se ha entrenado durante todo el verano para ser el más rápido de su clase, pero su objetivo se ve frustrado por la nueva chica del colegio. A pesar de ello, pronto se hacen amigos y crean el reino secreto de Terabithia.

programme.title: Miss you already
programme.desc: La amistad entre dos amigas de toda la vida se pone a prueba cuando una comienza una familia y la otra cae enferma.

programme.title: Negación
programme.desc: Drama judicial basado en el libro 'History On Trial'. La película cuenta el juicio entre la autora del libro, Deborah E. Lipstadt, y David Irving, famoso periodista admirador de Hitler al que ella había acusado de negar el holocausto, motivo por el que él se querelló contra ella por difamaciones.

programme.title: Escándalo en el poder
programme.desc: Tras el terrible vertido de un petrolero, un congresista decidido a ir contra la empresa petrolera, se ve involucrado en un escándalo sexual.

programme.desc: Cuando el desafortunado reportero del NY Times, Michael Finkel (Jonah Hill) conoce a Christian Longo (James Franco) –el cual ha robado su identidad– su investigación se convierte en una tensa persecución entre ratón y gato.

programme.desc: Kennedy hereda un rancho en un pequeño pueblo.

programme.desc: Reencuentro con un primer amor: el reto de no caer dos veces.

programme.desc: Dos vecinos forman un fuerte vínculo después de que ambos sospechen de actividades extramatrimoniales de sus cónyuges. Sin embargo, acuerdan mantener su vínculo platónico para no cometer errores similares.

programme.title: Happy together
programme.desc: Lai Yiu-Kai y Ho Po-Wing viven una apasionada relación. Viajan desde Hong Kong a Argentina para empezar de cero una nueva vida, pero la llegada al nuevo país parece transformar las cosas entre ellos y Ho, de repente, abandona a Lai. Un día Ho reaparece, pero nada es ya como antes.

programme.title: Zoe
programme.desc: Dos compañeros en un revolucionario laboratorio diseñan la tecnología que mejora y perfecciona relaciones románticas. Mientras su trabajo progresa, sus descubrimientos se hacen más profundos.

programme.title: The Escort
programme.desc: Desesperado por una buena historia, un periodista adicto al sexo se sumerge en el mundo de las señoritas de compañía de lujo cuando comienza a seguirle los pasos a una prostituta licenciada en Stanford.

programme.title: Mea culpa
programme.desc: Simon y Franck son amigos, compañeros y ambos buenos policías. Pero sus vidas se derrumban cuando Simon, conduciendo borracho, provoca un trágico accidente de tráfico. Seis años después, ya fuera de la policía y divorciado de su mujer Alice, Simon se ve obligado actuar cuando su familia está en peligro. El dúo con Franck se recompone, aunque persisten las zonas oscuras de su pasado común.

programme.title: Los cien pasos
programme.desc: Peppino Impastato es un joven militante de izquierda que a finales de los setenta (cuando casi nadie se atreve a hablar de la m…

programme.desc: Un grupo de cuatro amigos hastiados de su propia existencia formado por el piloto de aviones Marcello, el magistrado Philippe, el cocinero Ugo y el productor audiovisual Michel deciden reunirse en una barroca mansión de París y dar rienda suelta a su gula hasta llegar a los límites del ser humano.

programme.title: Dog soldiers
programme.desc: Un escuadrón de soldados británicos, de entrenamiento por los remotos páramos escoceses, encuentra a un capitán de las fuerzas...

programme.title: La Primera Navidad
programme.desc: Un ladrón y un sacerdote viajan 2.000 años atrás y deben encontrar las figuras de la Natividad.

programme.title: Amanece en Edimburgo
programme.desc: Dos soldados regresan a su casa en Edimburgo para reanudar su vida romántica y familiar.

programme.title: El Furgón
programme.desc: A consecuencia de un accidente de tráfico, tres delincuentes escapan del furgón policial.

programme.title: Memoria Perdida
programme.desc: Tras sufrir un golpe en la cabeza, un periodista de Chicago pierde la memoria y emprende un largo viaje.

programme.title: 50 sombras muy oscuras
programme.desc: Por fin descubriremos qué pasaría si Christian Grey fuera negro en lugar de blanco, rico y en lugar de tener un cuarto rojo del dolor tuviera una sala de juegos de colores… Divertida comedia protagonizada por Marlon Wayans y con un desternillante guión, escrito por él mismo y Rick Alvarez.

programme.title: Una noche con mi exsuegro
programme.desc: Durante una escala en Los Ángeles, el Señor Gallo, un testarudo y siempre ocupado hombre de negocios, decide ir a darle una sorpresa a su hija Ginnie. Pero una vez llega a su casa, descubre que ella se ha marchado sin dar explicaciones.

programme.title: El sexo opuesto
programme.desc: Una apuesta es una apuesta, así lo narra Vince, un abogado especializado en divorcios y el más exitoso de Nueva Inglaterra. Para Vince, la vida es una gran competición y perder no forma parte de sus planes.

programme.title: El club de las madres solteras
programme.desc: Cuando cinco madres solteras luchadoras apartan sus diferencias para formar un grupo de apoyo, encuentran la inspiración y la risa en su nueva hermandad, y se ayudan unas a otras a superar los obstáculos a los que se enfrentan.

programme.title: En temporada baja
programme.desc: Sigue la supuesta camaradería formada por Alberto, "el crack", quien fue un exitoso representante de futbolistas que ahora vive en un camping a las afueras de Valencia, y Charly, un policía divorciado que duerme en el trabajo.

programme.title: Ese Poli Es Un Panoli
programme.desc: Las cosas no salen como se planearon cuando un detective implacable planea una vigilancia en la casa de los Robbersons, junto a la cual está la de un matón de la mafia.

programme.title: Un Diploma Muy Caro
programme.desc: John Plummer (Jason Lee) es un hombre trabajador como cualquier otro que está a punto de casarse con su novia desde hace muchos años, Elaine (Leslie Mann), ahora que han ahorrado 30 000 dólares para el pago inicial de la casa de sus sueños. Pero, años antes, John hizo la olvidada promesa de pagar la matrícula de su sobrina Noreen (Tammy Blanchard) si entraba a una buena universidad. Milagrosamente, Noreen fue aceptada nada más y nada menos que en la Universidad de Harvard, y ahora lo único que necesita de su tío John son otros 29 879 dólares para su matrícula. Como no puede decirle a Elaine que necesita ganar 30 000 dólares adicionales en dos semanas, John recurre a su amigo Duff (Tom Green), quien lo convence de involucrarse por un corto tiempo en delitos menores. La vida de John rápidamente se derrumba cuando cada uno de los alocados timos de Duff se sale de control.

programme.title: No Me Mientas Que Te Creo
programme.desc: Los populares cómicos Richard Pryor y Gene Wilder son un par de mentirosos patológicos hechos el uno para el otro.

programme.title: Exceso De Equipaje
programme.desc: Alicia Silverstone es una chica rica, pero está tan harta de que su padre no se nocupe ella en absoluto que decide fingir su propio secuestro para llamar así su atención. Todo sale según sus planes hasta que un ladrón (Benicio del Toro) roba el coche en cuyo maletero está escondida.

programme.title: Hellgate: La puerta del infierno
programme.desc: Un hombre es falsamente acusado de espionaje y enviado a la brutal prisión de Hellgate. Tras un fallido intento de fuga, es condenado al aislamiento. Cuando una plaga asola la prisión, encuentra una inesperada redención en medio del caos.

programme.title: Robo a mano armada
programme.desc: El capitán Starlight (Sam Neill) se ha convertido en una leyenda.

programme.title: Duelo en el desfiladero
programme.desc: Un agente de la línea de escena investiga una serie de robos aceptando el trabajo de un ayudante de sheriff en un pueblo fronterizo de Arizona.

programme.title: El maquinista de La General
programme.desc: El maquinista de La General - Cuando los espías de la Unión roban la querida locomotora de un ingeniero, éste la persigue sin ayuda y directamente a través de las líneas enemigas.

programme.title: El hombre del presidente 2
programme.desc: El presidente asigna a un especialista en contraterrorismo la tarea de localizar a un terrorista sospechoso de planear la activación de un dispositivo nuclear en Estados Unidos.

programme.title: Lidice
programme.desc: Tras una pelea en un bar, un padre borracho mata a su hijo accidentalmente. Šima es condenado por asesinato y enviado a prisión.

programme.title: Los timadores
programme.desc: Un estafador de poca monta ha roto las lealtades entre su madre separada y su nueva novia, quienes son estafadores de alto riesgo con sus propios ángulos para jugar.

programme.title: Te pido un taxi
programme.desc: Rodrigo está seguro de poder conquistarlas a todas, y nunca se queda con ninguna, porque para él, el amor no existe. En éste, su juego, se encontrará con Sol, quién romperá toda regla que él se ha impuesto.

programme.title: El cadillac de Dolan
programme.desc: Un profesor de ciencia de una escuela de Las Vegas (Wes Bentley) intentará vengarse de los asesinos de su mujer (Emmanuelle Vaugier), una banda mafiosa liderada por el temible Jimmy Dolan (Christian Slater). Adaptación de la historia corta de Stephen King.

programme.title: El club de los incomprendidos
programme.desc: A Valeria le ha cambiado la vida por completo. La separación de sus padres la ha llevado a trasladarse a Madrid con su madre. Eso supone muchas cosas nuevas. Casa, instituto, amigos…La cosa se complica todavía más cuando Valeria se ve obligada a asistir al grupo de terapia que organiza el psicólogo del instituto. Allí se encontrará con otros compañeros que también se ven obligados a ir pero lo que parece un mal comienzo paralajoven adolescente, no es más que el inicio de una increíble experiencia vital nuevos amigos, una ciudad llena de posibilidades, acariciar la madurez y sobre todo descubrir que el primer amor es bastante más complicado de lo que se dice en loscuentos de princesas.

programme.title: Albert Nobbs
programme.desc: Irlanda, siglo XIX. Una mujer (Glenn Close) se ve atrapada en un triángulo amoroso inusual. Se disfraza de hombre para poder trabajar y sobrevivir, pero 30 años después se encuentra perdida en su propia prisión...

programme.title: El regreso de Aladino
programme.desc: Después de liberar a Bagdad de las garras de su terrible visir, Aladin está aburrido en palacio. Todavía no ha decidido pedir matrimonio a la princesa. Pero un terrible dictador, Shah Zaman, se invita al Palacio y anuncia que ha venido a tomar la ciudad y casarse con la Princesa. Aladin no tiene más remedio que huir del Palacio. Intentará recuperar a su antiguo Genio y así, volver para liberar a la ciudad y salvar a su novia.

programme.title: El niño de barro
programme.desc: En 1912, en Buenos Aires, una serie de niños son asesinados de manera brutal. Mateo, un niño de diez años, oculta que en sus pesadillas es testigo de los crímenes, pero cuando la policía lo descubre, se convierte en el principal sospechoso.

programme.title: Hijo de Caín
programme.desc: Nico es un adolescente de extraño carácter, inteligencia excepcional y una obsesión: el ajedrez. Carlos y Coral, preocupados por su hijo, contratan al psicólogo infantil Julio Beltrán. Descubrir la verdad a tiempo será la única opción para evitar que la esencia del mal acabe dominando sus vidas.

programme.title: Iceberg
programme.desc: Mirada sobre las primeras decisiones que marcan la adolescencia sin adultos de los protagonistas. Entre en "Kids" de Larry Clark y en "Elephant" de Gus Van Sant, Velázquez nos pone ante tres historias en las que sólo asoma una punta, como en un iceberg.

programme.title: Anabel
programme.desc: Tras la marcha, en circunstancias algo turbias, de Anabel, sus dos compañeras de piso deben buscar a alguien más con quien compartir el alquiler. El elegido es un señor mayor que logra ganarse su confianza, pero que pronto se descubrirá como una presencia extraña e inquietante.

programme.title: En temporada baja
programme.desc: Sigue la supuesta camaradería formada por Alberto, "el crack", quien fue un exitoso representante de futbolistas que ahora vive en un camping a las afueras de Valencia, y Charly, un policía divorciado que duerme en el trabajo.

programme.title: Un misterio para Aurora Teagarden: El juego del gato y el raton
programme.desc: Aurora Teagarden volvera a enfrentarse a la resolucion de un nuevo crimen cuando un misterioso criminal empieza a dejarle enigmaticas pistas.

programme.title: Un gran día
programme.desc: Un ex convicto obligado a abandonar a su familia, vuelve en secreto para conocer a su hija. Pero antes debe resolver una vieja deuda del pasado.

programme.title: Becoming Evil: Cult of Personality: The Monster Within and Among Us
programme.desc: Episode One discusses 'The Monster Within And Among Us', and discusses Jack The Ripper (even though he's not American), since he is pretty much the first recognized serial killer. Since a lack of real footage is obvious, this episode uses footage from an old black and white move, loosely based on Jack The Ripper.

programme.title: Like A Bat Outta Hell
programme.desc: A young group of avid documentary film makers are sent to shoot in the vast extremes of the South Australian wilderness. They end up in a place called Nowhere Else. What transpires there is devastatingly, like nothing else on Earth.

programme.title: El monstruo humano AKA The Human Monster
programme.desc: Agente de seguros-medico cobra polizas de hombres asesinados por un residente desfigurado del hogar para ciegos donde actua como medico de guardia.

programme.title: En tierras peligrosas
programme.desc: Un hombre que acaba de enviudar es sorprendido en su remota casa de campo por un policía que persigue a dos criminales. A éstos se les unirán el resto de la banda criminal y el socio del policía, en un enfrentamiento de bandos mortal.

programme.title: Tiempo límite (2015)
programme.desc: Perseguido por policías y mafiosos de toda la ciudad, decide hacerse un seguro de vida para que su hija lo cobre cuando él no esté. Solo tiene que mantenerse vivo 21 días hasta que la póliza tenga validez. No va a ser fácil.

programme.title: Amenaza terrorista
programme.desc: Ewan es un agente del Servicio Secreto cuya misión consiste en capturar y eliminar a Ash, un terrorista suicida, y a la célula a la que pertenece. Mientras tanto, Ash se enfrenta a un dilema moral.

programme.title: El Caballero de las Sombras
programme.desc: Cuenta la historia de un legendario cazador de demonios (Jackie Chan) que persigue a los monstruos que se adentran en la dimensión de los seres humanos y que cuenta con la ayuda de un abogado y de un grupo de bestias dispuestas a luchar contra el Mal.

programme.title: Sin escapatoria
programme.desc: Shannon presencia un asesinato y huye de policías corruptos. Jack, un exagente, la ayuda a sobrevivir.

programme.title: Last Man Down
programme.desc: Tras una pandemia, John protege a María, portadora de una posible cura, de unos mercenarios.

programme.title: Shorta
programme.desc: Jens y Mike quedan atrapados en un gueto tras una muerte bajo custodia policial ante una turba vengativa.

programme.title: Mercenarios de élite
programme.desc: Mercenarios protegen tecnología mortal y rescatan a la hija de un CEO secuestrada por terroristas.

programme.title: Sicario: El Día del Soldado
programme.desc: La guerra contra el narcotráfico se intensifica cuando la frontera entre Estados Unidos y México se vuelve aún más brutal.

programme.title: Mandíbulas
programme.desc: Bienvenido al Lago Negro. Este tranquilo paraje es el último lugar en el que uno esperaría encontrar un reptil de 9 metros de la especie Crocodylus, más conocida como cocodrilo. Es en este lago donde una paleontóloga neoyorquina con fobia a la naturaleza, que ha sido enviada a regañadientes para su primera misión de campo real, se une a un excéntrico multimillonario para encontrar esta amenaza.

programme.title: No Respires
programme.desc: Cuenta la historia de tres jóvenes que planifican a la perfección los robos que hacen de casa en casa. Cuando entran a uno de esos hogares, atacan al inquilino, un hombre ciego y solitario. Tan pronto como intentan huir de la casa, se cambian los roles y los jóvenes se encuentran luchando por su supervivencia contra el ciego.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Un grupo de documentalistas se traslada a la selva amazónica para localizar a la tribu indígena de los Shirishama. Este grupo está formado por una directora de cine, Terri Flores (Jennifer Lopez), un antropólogo, Steve Cale (Eric Stoltz), un encargado de sonido, Gary Dixon (Owen Wilson), un cámara, Danny Rich (Ice Cube), un narrador, Warren Westridge (Jonathan Hyde) y una productora, Denise Kahlberg (Kari Wuhrer). A ellos se les une Paul Sarone (Jon Voight), un misterioso ex-sacerdote convertido en cazador, que asegura saber dónde se encuentran los Shirishama, por lo que se convierte en su guía. Pero, en realidad, a donde les dirige es a la caza de un reptil único en el mundo: una inmensa serpiente anaconda de doce metros de largo.
